Да ведь, Хэр-л… то есть, Джоанна, они не видят праздника от года до года; никогда не ходят ни в цирк, ни в театр, ни на представления с неграми, никуда.", "— И в церковь не ходят?"]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "043-029-0060", "tag": "p", "text": "“Nor church.”", "sha256": "758b963ea7a2f078f7be512bd76cda51ac9e5b5cf0b11e2cb3b623cc15c578dc", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[60]", "source_html": "“Nor church.”"}, {"id": "043-029-0061", "tag": "p", "text": "“But you always went to church.”", "sha256": "98f075d65ca3fb29e18baf5851e531cac5533c497c4eda2147c42c09288dcdd3", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[61]", "source_html": "“But you always went to church.”"}, {"id": "043-029-0062", "tag": "p", "text": "Well, I was gone up again. But I didn’t do it pretty good, and when I got done I see she warn’t satisfied. She says:", "sha256": "e52e0cdd9f84b6be7f45c4460764a6645e0a3b95237ee611718f25b62166a182", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[62]", "source_html": "Well, I was gone up again. I forgot I was the old man’s servant. But next minute I whirled in on a kind of an explanation how a valley was different from a common servant and had to go to church whether he wanted to or not, and set with the family, on account of its being the law. But I didn’t do it pretty good, and when I got done I see she warn’t satisfied. She says:"}, {"id": "043-029-0063", "tag": "p", "text": "“Honest injun, now, hain’t you been telling me a lot of lies?”", "sha256": "ce20873bfeb5b1fe0a094bc37020e7b09820c283eee3f2a57c861a624fd68824", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[63]", "source_html": "“Honest injun, now, hain’t you been telling me a lot of lies?”"}, {"id": "043-029-0064", "tag": "source_caption", "text": "Honest Injun", "sha256": "0f71946b47540c48e58443478e82e392fe8d704d5f9a0a7af448c63c6dbc7c7e", "source_location": "illustration-index/#c26-224", "image_id": "c26-224"}, {"id": "043-029-0065", "tag": "p", "text": "“Honest injun,” says I.", "sha256": "f428a00b4e46608618be8c99bc68000af2c13976a30f82de6ba99973c30d93b5", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[65]", "source_html": "“Honest injun,” says I."}, {"id": "043-029-0066", "tag": "p", "text": "“None of it at all?”", "sha256": "59f94b42cf8df7635375026f8f8a4bb86b2a20da3881248ed420bdf91d201f8f", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[66]", "source_html": "“None of it at all?”"}, {"id": "043-029-0067", "tag": "p", "text": "“None of it at all. Not a lie in it,” says I.", "sha256": "6b0a87b813a45110e885c0f6124f5aeff46c4d8d21f4ceb44b698a1948581683", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[67]", "source_html": "“None of it at all. Not a lie in it,” says I."}, {"id": "043-029-0068", "tag": "p", "text": "“Lay your hand on this book and say it.”", "sha256": "a45c09a82d59c8c29a7d1079b720c139e7c2de4e896c1e15953083740e799876", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[68]", "source_html": "“Lay your hand on this book and say it.”"}, {"id": "043-029-0069", "tag": "p", "text": "I see it warn’t nothing but a dictionary, so I laid my hand on it and said it. So then she looked a little better satisfied, and says:", "sha256": "44058f655adc2c1fba498d78e20a7c388c5b74c1bdc6ae2bea406c59427aec67", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[69]", "source_html": "I see it warn’t nothing but a dictionary, so I laid my hand on it and said it. So then she looked a little better satisfied, and says:"}, {"id": "043-029-0070", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, then, I’ll believe some of it; but I hope to gracious if I’ll believe the rest.”", "sha256": "b172987563070bba5dfd12e4342481acab04834f88076e87cd29c07b817adf26", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[70]", "source_html": "“Well, then, I’ll believe some of it; but I hope to gracious if I’ll believe the rest.”"}, {"id": "043-029-0071", "tag": "p", "text": "“What is it you won’t believe, Joe?” says Mary Jane, stepping in with Susan behind her. “It ain’t right nor kind for you to talk so to him, and him a stranger and so far from his people. How would you like to be treated so?”", "sha256": "47c0c8fc5f11ad4cbfb2b8ee8cb62133fe516c5e5c1b6d65087b9502b0db4a30", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[71]", "source_html": "“What is it you won’t believe, Joe?” says Mary Jane, stepping in with Susan behind her. “It ain’t right nor kind for you to talk so to him, and him a stranger and so far from his people. How would you like to be treated so?”"}, {"id": "043-029-0072", "tag": "p", "text": "“That’s always your way, Maim—always sailing in to help somebody before they’re hurt. I hain’t done nothing to him. He’s told some stretchers, I reckon, and I said I wouldn’t swallow it all; and that’s every bit and grain I did say. I reckon he can stand a little thing like that, can’t he?”", "sha256": "0009fd0f4348cf39855f1a74a1143d30545366f1a76f35ad302b9d1f571994b1", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[72]", "source_html": "“That’s always your way, Maim—always sailing in to help somebody before they’re hurt. I hain’t done nothing to him. He’s told some stretchers, I reckon, and I said I wouldn’t swallow it all; and that’s every bit and grain I did say. I reckon he can stand a little thing like that, can’t he?”"}, {"id": "043-029-0073", "tag": "p", "text": "“I don’t care whether ’twas little or whether ’twas big; he’s here in our house and a stranger, and it wasn’t good of you to say it. If you was in his place it would make you feel ashamed; and so you oughtn’t to say a thing to another person that will make them feel ashamed.”", "sha256": "a91d3921cd6b6b70126c310c43c77f6ecdf341ed730baf3e6edbdc89326e012c", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[73]", "source_html": "“I don’t care whether ’twas little or whether ’twas big; he’s here in our house and a stranger, and it wasn’t good of you to say it. If you was in his place it would make you feel ashamed; and so you oughtn’t to say a thing to another person that will make them feel ashamed.”"}, {"id": "043-029-0074", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, Mam, he said—”", "sha256": "6122077d79891f378b2a699ad0c2e9bf9a6a1779707e7a608ed31f49da8c4970", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[74]", "source_html": "“Why, Mam, he said—”"}, {"id": "043-029-0075", "tag": "p", "text": "“It don’t make no difference what he said—that ain’t the thing. The thing is for you to treat him kind, and not be saying things to make him remember he ain’t in his own country and amongst his own folks.”", "sha256": "c8e2a96ef9c669ca7ad256ab5480f2c16409cb5c9d1d0a1784696ce8e3a48cea", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[75]", "source_html": "“It don’t make no difference what he said—that ain’t the thing. The thing is for you to treat him kind, and not be saying things to make him remember he ain’t in his own country and amongst his own folks.”"}, {"id": "043-029-0076", "tag": "p", "text": "I says to myself, this is a girl that I’m letting that old reptile rob her of her money!", "sha256": "62e970b678a3f01cedb5997ad2791b60ff044b8a8a76dc83ff85aacad1f7efd2", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[76]", "source_html": "I says to myself, this is a girl that I’m letting that old reptile rob her of her money!"}, {"id": "043-029-0077", "tag": "p", "text": "Then Susan she waltzed in; and if you’ll believe me, she did give Hare-lip hark from the tomb!", "sha256": "0175244dc125d74deb248f1aa0130fc6c5537609ecebce364ea65e6e83ad3e80", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[77]", "source_html": "Then Susan she waltzed in; and if you’ll believe me, she did give Hare-lip hark from the tomb!"}, {"id": "043-029-0078", "tag": "p", "text": "Says I to myself, and this is another one that I’m letting him rob her of her money!", "sha256": "1d8d6c361cb021d88ce62e60216799b35460807870bd2ef634f5eda3968679a3", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[78]", "source_html": "Says I to myself, and this is another one that I’m letting him rob her of her money!"}, {"id": "043-029-0079", "tag": "p", "text": "Then Mary Jane she took another inning, and went in sweet and lovely again—which was her way; but when she got done there warn’t hardly anything left o’ poor Hare-lip. Я забыл, что я слуга старика. Но в следующую минуту я уже пустился в объяснения, как это слуга-«долина» отличается от обыкновенного слуги и обязан ходить в церковь, хочет он того или нет, и сидеть вместе с семьёй, потому что таков закон. Но вышло у меня не очень ловко, и когда я кончил, то увидел, что она не удовлетворена. Она говорит:", "source_sha256": "e52e0cdd9f84b6be7f45c4460764a6645e0a3b95237ee611718f25b62166a182", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "c895f8040fe71ed3afd126e1bcbe23f358096a905959e1dc7bd1c529bb0b81d6"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0063", "target": "— Ну-ка, по-честному, как индеец, — разве ты не наврал мне с три короба?", "source_sha256": "ce20873bfeb5b1fe0a094bc37020e7b09820c283eee3f2a57c861a624fd68824", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "e6eee3d39d0245e571138a73ca0d36c27c9c6f1dee4fd0043711e0969330dd0a"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0064", "target": "Честное индейское", "source_sha256": "0f71946b47540c48e58443478e82e392fe8d704d5f9a0a7af448c63c6dbc7c7e", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0064", "tag": "source_caption", "target_sha256": "0dc41ba14cc7e9524c64b0b32f86f80d7c5b8cdf5ed442180764dfb7aa2ebdd0"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0065", "target": "— Честное индейское, — говорю я.", "source_sha256": "f428a00b4e46608618be8c99bc68000af2c13976a30f82de6ba99973c30d93b5", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0065", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "7ad3dc918cc9cb48e47d3b479ea11692c72c847397717a3546e34142c1c0301a"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0066", "target": "— Ни капельки не наврал?", "source_sha256": "59f94b42cf8df7635375026f8f8a4bb86b2a20da3881248ed420bdf91d201f8f", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0066", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d2167a57d3964cafd9b7f4581cfb2ba8afd0fa7962d55c3cfc8459347f244439"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0067", "target": "— Ни капельки. Ни одного слова вранья, — говорю я.", "source_sha256": "6b0a87b813a45110e885c0f6124f5aeff46c4d8d21f4ceb44b698a1948581683", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0067", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "83835b61177658e1967fd2b0b8db9903f56325d04a044b6cac64866e456ce81e"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0068", "target": "— Положи руку на эту книгу и скажи это.", "source_sha256": "a45c09a82d59c8c29a7d1079b720c139e7c2de4e896c1e15953083740e799876", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0068", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "e6db2dd30e54045fe6afc6e64cfd5d071eb674bd3bdf9476fc4066f359855db9"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0069", "target": "Я увидел, что это всего-навсего словарь, и положил на него руку и сказал. Тогда она стала глядеть немного более довольной и говорит:", "source_sha256": "44058f655adc2c1fba498d78e20a7c388c5b74c1bdc6ae2bea406c59427aec67", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0069", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "49b484aa18899c756f3e12cca76c79ccdfcc857323ad87ae8b3f4e83afb608a7"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0070", "target": "— Ну ладно, кое-чему я поверю; но, помилуй бог, всему остальному я ни за что не поверю.", "source_sha256": "b172987563070bba5dfd12e4342481acab04834f88076e87cd29c07b817adf26", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0070", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "43cf8b62b905550a97f519841f4f48c1b24a0dd389fb70eb2826e1ac558b118f"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0071", "target": "— Чему это ты не поверишь, Джо? — говорит Мэри Джейн, входя, а за ней Сьюзан. — Нехорошо и недобро так разговаривать с ним: он чужой и так далеко от своих. Тебе самой понравилось бы, если бы с тобой так обращались?", "source_sha256": "47c0c8fc5f11ad4cbfb2b8ee8cb62133fe516c5e5c1b6d65087b9502b0db4a30", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0071", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "69db09dddf0922ee8b5f51c774b50e124ebc9d141a2ec278ec3b8f42ac5712ed"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0072", "target": "— Ты всегда такая, Мэйм — вечно бросаешься на помощь, прежде чем кого-нибудь обидят. Я ему ничего не сделала. Он наплёл всяких небылиц, по-моему, а я сказала, что не проглочу всё это; вот и всё до последней крошки, что я сказала. Думаю, он такую малость переживёт, разве нет?", "source_sha256": "0009fd0f4348cf39855f1a74a1143d30545366f1a76f35ad302b9d1f571994b1", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0072", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d8257d3134d97aa5bfc9c252fea608768ee5443b00510cd257aef9c94b093f6a"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0073", "target": "— Мне всё равно, малость это или не малость; он у нас в доме и чужой, и с твоей стороны нехорошо было так говорить.
